svg.title: Coupeville Velvet bench wiring diagram
svg.desc: Physical-style reference using the repository's guitar component drawings. Outer neck and bridge pickups feed a three-way blade and push-pull volume. Nashville middle pickup feeds a B500K blend pot. The push-pull switches between blend and Nashville solo. A discrete five-way voice switch selects one of four resistor-capacitor shunts to ground.
svg.text: Electrical layout using the K7RHY wiring component library · 2026-08-23 experiment · physical lug orientation must be checked
P1 C ← wiper · DOWN/NC → bus · UP/NO open
GROUND / SHIELD RETURN: pickup grounds · pot casings · outer-volume LOW · P2 UP · jack sleeve
Five-way global voice selector · one discrete 1P5T pole of a 4P5T switch
This voice network is a shunt from the combined bus to ground; the audio path to the jack does not pass through an RC pair.
24-lug 4P5T example · only right-hand pole P4 wired
BENCH REFERENCE · functional 3-way pads and switch orientation require continuity checks · no treble bleed or continuous tone pot · body fit unverified
